title: Fantasy Player News

items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) out for Thursday night against Seattle
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) has been ruled out for the Broncos contest against the Seahawks on Thursday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Surtain will miss yet another game, but with the Bronco's having a mini bye week, hopefully he can return for Week 7. Denver will have to make it work without him.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba practices in full Wednesday, no injury designation
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was upgraded to a full practice on Wednesday and has no injury designation for Thursday night.
items.impact: JSN was initially listed as limited due to an ankle injury, but it looks like he will be a full go against Denver. Lock him into starting lineups.

items.title: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jermaine Eluemunor did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Eluemunor suffered the calf injury in Week 5. Head coach John Harbaugh called him day-to-day on Monday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was limited at New York's practice on Wednesday as a result. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

items.title: Keeanu Benton (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Keeanu Benton did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Benton suffered the ankle injury in Week 5 against the Colts. His status is uncertain heading into the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) not ready to practice yet
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said, "not right now" when asked if Jordyn Tyson could practice this week.
items.impact: Moore adds that Tyson is "progressing well." He remains week-to-week for now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) was absent from New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parham was not able to practice on Wednesday. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 6, which would be less than ideal for the Jets ahead of a divisional matchup against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jarquez Hunter signs with Saints
items.desc: The Saints signed Jarquez Hunter.
items.impact: Hunter will add depth in the backfield for New Orleans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie has been out for over four weeks due to an ankle injury, but he recently had his practice window opened up and was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. It looks like he will be back in the lineup in the near future, although it's unclear whether or not his return will come in Week 6.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb (quad) practicing in full for Week 6
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb is practicing in full for Week 6 against the Packers.
items.impact: Lamb left the game late last week with a quad injury. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

items.title: Breece Hall (quad) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Hall was not able to practice on Wednesday. He's still managing a quad injury and is currently considered week-to-week. It looks like Braelon Allen will again be the starter for the Jets this week, which will give him potential flex value for this game at least.
